_meta.source: SYNTHESISED to the real system.vessels/system.bodies wire shape (Gonogo.KSP/KspHost.cs BuildVesselRosterEntry -> Sitrep.Host/SystemViewProvider.cs BuildSystemVessels), values checked against Assembly-CSharp.dll (ilspycmd decompile, KSP_Data/Managed): Vessel.GetCrewCount/GetCrewCapacity, ProtoVessel.GetVesselCrew, ProtoPartSnapshot.partPrefab.CrewCapacity, CommNet.CommNetVessel.OnStart/GetControlLevel. Five vessels covering the roster states an operator actually sees for real craft: a crewed station with a direct link, an uncrewed relay probe with a relay link, a crewed lander with a relay link, a crewed orbiter with a real no-link reading (CommNet resolved and reports None, a genuine ops fact), and one genuinely-unresolved contact (every field but name/situation omitted -- the producer's own transient 'nothing to read this tick' case: a scene-transition race or a vessel whose protoVessel/connection hasn't settled yet). Debris and asteroid entries were removed here (FleetRoster now filters system.vessels down to actual craft client-side -- see isRosterCraft in index.tsx -- since VesselType.Debris/SpaceObject structurally never get a CommNetVessel attached and are not fleet vessels an operator means by 'Fleet'). There is no reliability/health signal behind any entry - this widget does not compute a per-vessel status.
